name: Calendar & Mail
description: Your calendars and email through the Mac's own Calendar and Mail apps, with every account you added there (iCloud, Google, Exchange). Nothing to sign in to. Mabel writes email drafts; you send them.
author: Mabel
prompt: For the user's calendar use calendar_events and calendar_add_event; for email use mail_search, mail_read and mail_draft (drafts only: the user sends). These cover every account on this Mac, Google included: don't ask the user to set up a connector for Google Calendar or Gmail.
